## Findings

1. **Czech plurals** in the cottage facts line ("6 pokoje") — fixed in T-058 (this PR).
2. **Gmail replies default to ranaji.deb@gmail.com**, not podpora@: Gmail → Settings → Accounts → "When replying to a message: Reply from the same address the message was sent to". Then replies to podpora@ mail go out as podpora@ automatically.
3. Settle debts briefly shows a cached amount before refreshing (300 → 100 Kč); the claim amount is computed on the server, so no wrong claim is possible.
